cs.t: Slightly off-topic, but a "lesser known accessory I use(d)" back in the 1970's was the Microwriter [1], a chording keyboard that provided for a typing speed not possible with normal keyboards.  I am a proficient (Pitman) touch typist, but after a clumsy learning curve, the Microwriter more than doubled my input speed. [1]  https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Microwriter
cs.th: Ask HN: What lesser-known accessories do you use with your computer?
